Subject: Aurora Technologies — Entity roster + PO routing kickoff

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per procurement's request, we'd like to capture the minimal set of vendor master details so our AP and sales systems can accept POs and remits from Aurora. Please see the fields below and attach any supporting docs (W-9, entity roster, bank remit note) if available: 

- Legal entity name (as appears on tax forms)
- Business type (LLC / Corp / Other)
- Tax ID / EIN (or country equivalent)
- Remit-to address (for invoices)
- Preferred invoice submission email and PO acknowledgement email
- Primary AP contact name and phone number
- Banking remit instructions (if you require a secure link, we'll send a DocuSign/secure portal)
- Any required PO reference format or mandatory fields

I've attached our vendor intake template to speed things up — feel free to return the CSV or a scanned W-9. If you'd like, Marissa and I can complete a brief mutual action plan and prioritize the PO routing setup this week.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form_2025.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Two quick clarifications so AP can ingest the record cleanly: 

1) Can you confirm the legal "remit-to" legal entity exactly as it should appear on our vendor master (including punctuation)? We have seen minor variations cause duplicate vendor records. You listed "Aurora Technologies, Inc." — please confirm that is the definitive remit name.

2) For banking instructions, we require either (a) a completed vendor banking form returned via DocuSign, or (b) a secure upload to our vendor portal. If Aurora prefers DocuSign, reply 'DocuSign' and we'll send the link (it includes an ACL so only your AP contact can view).

3) If Aurora issues POs with a specific PO reference prefix (e.g., AUR-), please confirm so our PO parser doesn't strip fields.

If you prefer, I can convert the attached CSV into our intake format and return it to you for signature.

Thanks — Marissa
